text: Hare said nothing of his suspicions.
Instead, before sunset, he quietly mixed fine river clay with white wood ash from the cooking fire, spreading a smooth, invisible circle around the stilts of the benteng.

When dawn came, the thieves' tracks were pressed into the clay with photographic clarity: broad, uneven pads and dragging claws that led straight across the clearing and stopped right at the front door of Hyena's sleeping hut!
Confronted before the council of animals, Hyena dropped his head in disgrace and fled into the thorn thickets, leaving the honest companions to share what remained in peace.
